docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Gītā in English with Śaṅkara's commentary on every verse, in the translation of A. Mahadeva Sastri of the Government Oriental Library, Mysore (1901).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Bhagavad-Gita, with the commentary of Sri Sankaracharya · Mahadeva Sastri, Alladi, d. 1926?, Sankaracarya · 1901, 520 scanned pages. Published 1901; A. Mahadeva Sastri died before 1940; the commentary is by Śaṅkara (eighth century); public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
